profile.headline: Software Developer at Orrba Systems LLC.
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience architecting and operating resilient, high-scale backend systems and distributed microservices using Java and Spring Boot. Proven expertise in leading REST-to-GraphQL API migrations, designing scalable platform tooling, and improving developer productivity through reusable abstractions and observability enhancements. Skilled in performance optimization, cloud-native AWS deployments, and end-to-end system ownership—from design and data modeling to production support and platform evolution. Passionate about building maintainable, large-scale systems that empower engineering teams and drive technical excellence.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed 2nd version of DrugHelp.care (www.drughelp.care). Used React.js as front end and used PHP Laravel framework for backend. Used Google APIs, Auto email using kernel, Site Mapping for google search
- Analyzed website and did all the required CRUD operations, developed database for system using MySQL with joins
- Worked with Agencies, Categories, Slots, Treatment Services, did many logical operations, generated public pages etc.

positions.title: Software development Intern
positions.description:
- Responsible for research and development of project from scratch and implemented backend and REST APIs of a web services -"utilitybelt (subuser management system)"
- Extensively used node.js framework express features mainly Server-side Programming, Routing, Middleware and Debugging. Used React.js for frontend
- Developed Rest services for various HTTP methods such as GET, POST, PUT and DELETE. Responsible for using Rest API to deal with JSON data. Invoke Restful API to get and post data from/to sendgrid. Created new system to map sendgrid's data with our data for subuser management.
- Architectural, technical and functional understanding of interfacing modules. Involved in different activities like design, development, unit testing and test case creation

positions.title: Information Services & Technology Student Support Assistant
positions.description:
- To ask student about their specifications for laptops and issuing them the best fit
- To update the database and format laptop periodically
- To help students/professors with technical issues and problems with respect to all devices
- To manage daily reports and paperwork and to file them accordingly

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: - A web-based application which provides a platform between Library system and users, implemented in java platform using eclipse application, applied all the steps of software engineering, Requirements Gathering and Analysis, Design Phase, Development, Testing, Deployment, User Guide, Maintenance, Used agile methodology

projects.title: Deal-With-Wheels
projects.description: - The website focused on international transportation with tracking facility, Used java technology (JSP-Servlet), HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript for event handling etc. Used Google APIs for pickup and drop off locations and tracking facility
